The known 6 ohm branch carries 6/6=1 A; junction conservation requires the unknown branch carry 4-1=3 A.
Unknown resistance R=6/3=2 ohm. Check: 6||2=1.5 ohm; total resistance 3+1.5=4.5 ohm and 18/4.5=4 A.
Energy and charge checks: 12 V+6 V=18 V and 1 A+3 A=4 A.

boundary.model: For finite positive R, the parallel equivalent satisfies 0 < R_p < 6 ohm. Thus 18/(3+6)=2 A < I_total < 18/3=6 A. Neither 1.5 A nor 7 A is possible. R->infinity is an open-branch limit approaching 2 A; R->0 is a short-branch limit approaching 6 A. These endpoints require leaving the finite positive R domain.
